qc.label_under_test: Weak, dense hum (11% of tokens reach 0.1 of a small max) that rises on talk-based mental-health treatment: counselling and therapy sessions, psychiatrists, psychoanalysis, psychodynamic work, where people talk through their problems; speech therapy and the word 'talking' bump it a little. Symptom lists and CBT jargon, where the + pole takes over, stay near zero. Physical medicine (surgery, physio, pharmacy) hums at the 0.1-0.2 baseline. Lateness adds nothing: 'too late' scores like 'too early', and the feeders' foreign too/late/tan words (demasiado, zu spät, поздно) do not carry through, apart from a small bump on the headline 'Too Little too Late?'.

neighbours.label: Weak, dense hum (11% of tokens reach 0.1 of a small max) that rises on talk-based mental-health treatment and the writing around it: counselling, therapy sessions, psychiatrists, psychoanalysis, psychodynamic work, support groups where people talk through their problems (about 0.2-0.65); mental-health book outlines and speech therapy also lift it (inverse found 0.46-0.55). Physical medicine (surgery, dentistry, nursing, vets) hums at the 0.1-0.2 baseline. Lateness: plain 'too late' / 'ran late' stays near zero, BUT the feeders' late signal does carry through in the discovered-too-late construction ('noticed / realised / found out too late that ...', 0.2-0.45 peaking on ' late'), so 'lateness adds nothing' was too strong.
fire: Her therapist encouraged her to talk openly about the panic attacks.
After the funeral he started grief counselling to work through his loss.
In psychoanalysis the patient lies on a couch and speaks freely.
The couples counsellor asked each of them to describe the argument.
His psychiatrist recommended weekly talk therapy alongside medication.
The support group met on Thursdays to share their struggles with depression.
A psychodynamic therapist explores how early relationships shape adult feelings.
The school counsellor listened as the boy described being bullied.
quiet: The orthopaedic surgeon set the broken bone and applied a cast.
The dentist filled two cavities and cleaned her teeth.
We got to the station too late and the train had gone.
The nurse changed the dressing on his leg wound twice a day.
The two friends talked for hours about football over coffee.
The radiologist examined the X-ray for signs of a fracture.
The meeting ran late, so dinner was cold by the time I got home.
The vet gave the dog a vaccine and checked its ears.
neighbours.notes: Loop-back QC after mapping the L0/L1 too/late feeders. Fire set tests the therapy core; near misses keep care/talk/lateness but drop talk-based mental-health treatment. The 'noticed too late that' bump was found in exploratory probes and is reported in the label but not scored here. Twitch chat was quiet; all sentences are the streamer's own.

predictions: 8/8 fire above the near misses (AUROC ~0.95+), median fire ~0.3, no near miss at 0.30
